name: my-osm-apk
description: Enveloppe Android de MY OSM. Le code source reste dans ../app : ce dossier ne contient que la coquille native.

scripts.sync: npm run web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../livrables/MY-OSM-debug.apk
scripts.web:nokeys: OSM_TARGET=apk VITE_TOMTOM_KEY= VITE_IDFM_API_KEY= VITE_MAPILLARY_TOKEN= VITE_METEOFRANCE_API_KEY= npm --prefix ../app run build
scripts.apk:nokeys: npm run web:nokeys && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../livrables/MY-OSM-sans-cles.apk
scripts.web:release: OSM_TARGET=apk MYOSM_DIAGNOSTICS=0 VITE_TOMTOM_KEY= VITE_IDFM_API_KEY= VITE_MAPILLARY_TOKEN= VITE_METEOFRANCE_API_KEY= npm --prefix ../app run build
scripts.apk:release: npm run web:release && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../livrables/MY-OSM.apk
